games.title: Neon Drift Circuit
games.tagline: Drift the neon, charge the boost, out-run five rivals under a giant synthwave sun.
games.pitch: Neon Drift Circuit: a synthwave arcade kart racer at night. Drift through glowing neon corners, charge drift boosts, hit boost pads and race five rivals over three laps on a track lined with glowing palm trees and a giant setting sun. Pumping synth music, a slick sci-fi HUD with speedometer, lap counter and position.
controls: Space: hold to drift, release for boost

games.title: Dune Raiders
games.tagline: Blast the scorpions, grab the gold, and run for the sun gate.
games.pitch: Dune Raiders: a desert top-down treasure hunt. Play a little robot explorer roaming a sun-baked desert ruin, blasting scorpion turrets and sand slimes, collecting ancient gold relics, and escaping through the glowing sun gate. Warm sand colours, long shadows, punchy blaster hits.

games.title: Starbloom Isles
games.tagline: Hop, stomp, and bloom: light the beacon across the floating sky.
games.pitch: Starbloom Isles: a bright, juicy toon 3D platformer. A little fox hops across floating sky islands, rope bridges and moving platforms collecting glowing star blooms, stomping grumpy slimes, and reaching the beacon portal on the last island. Cheerful, saturated, sunny.
controls: Space: jump (tap again mid-air to double-jump)

games.title: Spire Climb
games.tagline: Hop the cloud spire, spin the platforms, and ring the great bell.
games.pitch: Spire Climb: a cozy spiral tower climb above the clouds as a cat, hopping up ledges, bridges and rotating platforms to ring the bell at the top

games.title: Riverbend Canyon
games.tagline: Paddle, hop, and splash down the red-rock river to the waterfall pool
games.pitch: Riverbend Canyon: a frog paddles and hops down a winding red-rock canyon river, leaping between rocks and rafts to reach the waterfall pool
controls: Space: jump (hold for a higher hop)

games.title: Canyon Runner
games.tagline: Chain the boost pads. Kiss the red rock. Beat the sunset clock.
games.pitch: Canyon Runner: a desert canyon hover-bike time trial. Rip through red-rock canyons at sunset on a hover-bike, chaining boost pads and hitting every checkpoint before the clock runs out. Warm orange stone, long shadows, dust trails, speed lines.

games.title: Neon Arena
games.tagline: Blast the swarm. Bank the cores. Outlast the clock.
games.pitch: Neon Arena: a fast top-down twin-stick-style arena shooter at night in a synthwave colosseum. A tiny hover-robot dashes around a glowing tiled arena, blasting waves of chasing spiky orbs and patrolling slimes, grabbing energy cores dropped across the floor, and surviving the timer. Neon pink and cyan light, dark night sky, punchy hits, screen shake, scifi HUD.
games.genre: Top-down synthwave arena shooter / wave survival
controls: WASD / arrows: dash around the arena

games.title: Cloudhop Meadows
games.tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way to the flower portal at the top of the sky!
games.pitch: Cloudhop Meadows: a bright, juicy 3D platformer across floating sky islands. Run, double-jump and dash between candy-coloured islands and wobbly mushroom platforms, collect glowing star seeds, dodge spinning thorn bars, and reach the giant blooming flower portal at the top. Cheerful music, a bouncy HUD with a seed counter and timer.
controls: Space: jump (tap again mid-air: double jump)

games.title: Bumble Dash
games.tagline: Dash, boing and double-jump the spring meadow — grab the carrots and beat the clock!
games.pitch: Bumble Dash: a bunny obstacle-course sprint through a sunny spring meadow. Dash, double-jump and bounce over hurdles, spinning bars and bounce pads, grab golden carrots along the way, and burst through the giant flower finish arch before the timer runs out. Bright, bouncy, cheerful.
controls: A / D or arrow keys: move
Space: jump, press again mid-air: double jump

games.title: Crystal Hollow
games.tagline: Blast the shadows. Gather the souls. Survive until dawn.
games.pitch: Crystal Hollow: a dark-fantasy first-person crystal hunt in a moonlit ruined arena. Blast waves of shadow slimes with a glowing wand-blaster, collect floating soul crystals, and survive until dawn. Eerie purple moonlight, glowing runes, chunky stylised stone ruins.

games.title: Frostbeak
games.tagline: Waddle, hop and belly-slide up a pink-dawn mountain to the summit igloo.
games.pitch: Frostbeak: a little penguin waddles and belly-slides across a snowy mountain, hopping between icy ledges and frozen floating floes to collect glittering fish, dodging rolling snowballs, and reaching the summit igloo. Crisp blue-white snow, pink dawn sky, cosy and playful.

games.title: Lantern Lane
games.tagline: Gather the lost lights, deliver the letters, and light the tree.
games.pitch: Lantern Lane: a cozy evening village collect-a-thon. Wander a warm little town at golden hour as a cat, gather lost lanterns and letters for the neighbours, chat with friendly villagers, and light the big lantern tree in the plaza. Soft acoustic music, a cozy rounded HUD, no rush.
controls: Walk up to a villager: chat

games.title: Lagoon Rush
games.tagline: Skim the turquoise, chain the boosts, and take the lead over three splashy laps.
games.pitch: Lagoon Rush: a sunny tropical jet-boat race. Skim across a turquoise lagoon past palm beaches, a striped lighthouse and buoy-lined lanes, hit boost pads and a big jump ramp, and beat three rival boats over three laps. Bright, splashy, summery, toon colours.

games.title: Cloudhop Meadows
games.tagline: Hop, dash and bloom your way up the candy-coloured sky islands!
games.pitch: Cloudhop Meadows: a bright, juicy 3D platformer across floating sky islands. Run, double-jump and dash between candy-coloured islands and wobbly mushroom platforms, collect glowing star seeds, dodge spinning thorn bars, and reach the giant blooming flower portal at the top. Cheerful music, a bouncy HUD with a seed counter and timer.
controls: Space: jump, press again mid-air for double jump

games.title: Lagoon Rush
games.tagline: Skim the turquoise, chain the boosts, and out-drive three rivals to the lighthouse.
games.pitch: Lagoon Rush: a sunny tropical jet-boat race. Skim across a turquoise lagoon past palm beaches, a striped lighthouse and buoy-lined lanes, hit boost pads and a big jump ramp, and beat three rival boats over three laps. Bright, splashy, summery, toon colours.
